verdict.rationale: All MCP-related evidence describes Granola acting as an MCP *server* — exposing its own meeting notes/transcripts as tools for other AI clients like Claude or ChatGPT to consume (granola-docs-3, -17, -35, -42, granola-probe-3). There is no evidence that Granola itself can act as an MCP client and plug in external MCP servers to use their tools within its own AI features (e.g., Granola Chat).
